strategy: Use one free core player for the prototype, then add one world-instrument library only where it materially strengthens LITD's Asian-influenced identity.

OSTINATO: Berlin Free Orchestra / Solo cello / sustained or legato
Berlin Free Orchestra / Celli a5 / sustains for reinforcement
STRINGS_LOW: Berlin Free Orchestra / Basses a4 / sustains
Berlin Free Orchestra / Celli a5 / sustains
MIND_MELODY: Berlin Free Orchestra / solo flute / legato
COMMON_COUNTERPOINT: Berlin Free Orchestra / solo clarinet / legato
Berlin Free Orchestra / violas a5 / sustains
CHOIR: SINEfactory Manifold / male and female ooh-ah-oh ensembles
ASH_CORRUPTION: SINEfactory Crucible / pipe organ as source
REAPER stock FX for pitch, delay, filtering and degradation
WORLD_TEXTURE: Original LITD field recordings and synthesized textures only; do not depend on redistributable third-party raw samples

identity_upgrade.priority: after the first complete free render is working
identity_upgrade.reason: One library covers many Asian instruments and percussion needed by LITD without forcing a collection of unrelated plugins.

WORLD_TEXTURE: Gamelan metals used as resampled musical texture only inside final mixed LITD works

identity_upgrade.art_direction_rule: Do not use an instrument merely as a stereotype marker. Write it into the Corps/Esprit/Commun grammar and combine it with the European public-domain source material so the result belongs to LITD.

fallback_paid_alternative.reason: Broad single-package world palette if the Kontakt-based workflow is rejected later.

licensing.rule: Sample libraries stay installed locally and are never committed or redistributed. Only newly rendered LITD musical works/stems may enter the game repository when the relevant library license permits use in music/audio productions.
